name: Theme
when_to_use: Always first in a UI file: palette, fonts, corner/stroke/gradient/shadow/tween/pop/punch helpers, Theme.screen() for a ScreenGui that scales on phones.

name: ChunkyText
when_to_use: Any TextLabel players must read: titles, labels, timers, status text.

name: StyledButton
when_to_use: Every clickable: buy, upgrade, play, claim, open shop, rebirth, toggle.

name: Panel
when_to_use: A window: shop, inventory, upgrades, settings, quests, with close X and dim backdrop.

name: Toast
when_to_use: Short notifications: earned coins, not enough cash, round started, unlocked.

name: CurrencyCounter
when_to_use: HUD pill for coins/gems/cash bound to a leaderstat; number ticks up and pops.

name: ProgressBar
when_to_use: XP, level, health, stamina, timer, capacity or goal progress bar with shine sweep.

name: RewardPopup
when_to_use: Big centre celebration: level up, chest/egg opened, unlock, win, rebirth.

name: PriceBillboard
when_to_use: World price tag on a buy pad / shop item (BillboardGui), green when affordable. Works in server Scripts.

name: FloatingText
when_to_use: Rising '+1' / '+$50' text over a world point for pickups, hits and payouts (client).
